{"turn":2,"units":[
{"unitId":"blue-1","x":1960,"y":1680,"facingDeg":0,"formation":"line","strength":592,"morale":79,"fatigue":3,"ammo":85,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[{"orderId":"b1-7","result":"not-arrived"}],"account":"Col. Aubry holds his line south of the river as before. The head of the enemy column comes out on to the bridge and he gives it volleys at under 200 m. He gets no other order during the turn and does not leave his position."},
{"unitId":"blue-2","x":1840,"y":1740,"facingDeg":40,"formation":"line","strength":545,"morale":75,"fatigue":6,"ammo":92,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[{"orderId":"b2-7","result":"carried-out"}],"account":"Col. Delacroix stands in line beside the 1st Battalion and fires on the head of the enemy column on the bridge until his order comes at about the fourteenth minute. The column is already recoiling. He then marches his battalion behind the 1st, to the west of the road, and forms line facing the bridge, as ordered, keeping his reserve in hand."},
{"unitId":"blue-3","x":2050,"y":1850,"facingDeg":0,"formation":"line","strength":200,"morale":85,"fatigue":0,"ammo":100,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[],"account":"Maj. Verneuil has no order and holds behind the infantry. He sees the enemy column come on to the bridge and fall back, and wants to charge, but there is no order and no clear field."},
{"unitId":"red-1","x":2050,"y":1370,"facingDeg":180,"formation":"column","strength":450,"morale":42,"fatigue":35,"ammo":95,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[{"orderId":"r1-7","result":"partly"}],"account":"Col. Brandt receives his order at about the third minute and marches at once down the road to the north end of the bridge, then drives his column on to it to seize it. Two battalions in line on either side of the far end pour volleys into the head of the column on the bridge, where it cannot deploy. After a heavy loss he draws back to the north end, not broken but shaken, and halts there.","departure":"Projection stops the column at the bridge head (2050,1380) with no casualties and no morale loss. The order is to seize the bridge; an aggressive colonel presses on to it and is shot down by the two battalions covering the far end, so the column loses about 200 men and morale falls to 42 before falling back to the same spot. The position matches; the strength and morale differ."},
{"unitId":"red-2","x":2250,"y":700,"facingDeg":180,"formation":"column","strength":650,"morale":70,"fatigue":7,"ammo":100,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[],"account":"Col. Hartmann has no new order and keeps his column where it is, by the book."},
{"unitId":"red-3","x":1550,"y":400,"facingDeg":180,"formation":"line","strength":220,"morale":85,"fatigue":0,"ammo":100,"status":"active","continuing":{"kind":"hold"},"orders":[],"account":"Maj. von Reiter has no new order and holds his position."}
],

"summary":"Red-1 reached the bridge at about minute 5 and, ordered to seize it, drove its column on to it. Blue-1 and Blue-2, in line on either side of the south end, fired on it. Unable to deploy on the bridge, the column lost about 200 men and was shaken; Brandt drew it back to the north end. At minute 14 Blue-2's order to move behind the 1st Battalion, to the west of the road, and form line facing the bridge arrived, and it carried it out; the column was already falling back. Blue-1's order to advance to the south end of the bridge was still on the road and was not acted on. Blue-3, Red-2 and Red-3 had no orders and held. Blue losses were about 8 men in Blue-1 and 5 in Blue-2."}
